long_biography.plain_text:
Brian Charles has spent more than two decades leading Arrow Marine Services, the Richmond, British Columbia shipyard within Arrow Transportation Systems. A trade report identified him as general manager in 2000, when a new heavy-lift hoist helped turn the operation into a full-service repair and storage centre. Later company publications described him as vice president of marketing and business development.

His remit has covered infrastructure investment, growth and customer work across fishing vessels, tugboats, barges and marine structures. The yard provides refits, steel and aluminium fabrication, painting, machining and emergency repairs. Charles remains a vice president at Arrow, while day-to-day yard management has passed to a division manager.
